text: One line is missing from the configuration: the lifetime of a one-time code.

text: What should the platform do: guess a number, or stop?

text: Lesson 3 gave each bank its own installation, inside its own perimeter, in two zones.
prefix: Lesson 3 gave each bank its own installation, inside its own perimeter, in two zones.

text: Each installation needs its own values, and this lesson shows where they come from and how they change.
prefix: Each installation needs its own values, and this lesson shows where they come from and how they change.

text: Many systems would guess.
prefix: Many systems would guess.

text: Somewhere in the code there is a constant, and the constant wins, quietly.
prefix: Somewhere in the code there is a constant, and the constant wins, quietly.

text: In heeyID, the code has no default value at all.
prefix: In heeyID, the code has no default value at all.

text: A default hidden in the code is a decision that nobody signed.
prefix: A default hidden in the code is a decision that nobody signed.

text: Nobody sees it, nobody approves it, and nobody can say when it changed.
prefix: Nobody sees it, nobody approves it, and nobody can say when it changed.

text: So the values live in one place: the OpenTofu configuration of the installation.
prefix: So the values live in one place: the OpenTofu configuration of the installation.

text: OpenTofu is the tool that describes the installation as code.
prefix: OpenTofu is the tool that describes the installation as code.

text: Its catalogue holds one value for each policy, and the default texts for consent, terms and notifications, in four languages.
prefix: Its catalogue holds one value for each policy, and the default texts for consent, terms and notifications, in four languages.

text: At setup, the platform reads this catalogue and writes it as version zero.
prefix: At setup, the platform reads this catalogue and writes it as version zero.

text: The proposer of version zero is the product, and each row has a mark that says: this is still the default.
prefix: The proposer of version zero is the product, and each row has a mark that says: this is still the default.

text: If one value is missing, the setup stops, with a clear error that names the value.
prefix: If one value is missing, the setup stops, with a clear error that names the value.

text: So the platform team sees the missing code lifetime in the first minute, not in a complaint from a customer a month later.
prefix: So the platform team sees the missing code lifetime in the first minute, not in a complaint from a customer a month later.

text: There is a second gate before the first customer.
prefix: There is a second gate before the first customer.

text: The installation does not start its service until the bank has at least one active app with a required level.
prefix: The installation does not start its service until the bank has at least one active app with a required level.

text: Until then, every journey answers: the service is not available.
prefix: Until then, every journey answers: the service is not available.

text: Two kinds of values sit in that configuration.
prefix: Two kinds of values sit in that configuration.

text: Policies are the rules of the bank for each customer journey: code lifetimes, attempt limits and waiting times.
prefix: Policies are the rules of the bank for each customer journey: code lifetimes, attempt limits and waiting times.

text: Installation settings belong to one zone: the hosts, the zone itself, whether test customers are allowed, the call timeouts, the breaker values and the access token lifetime.
prefix: Installation settings belong to one zone: the hosts, the zone itself, whether test customers are allowed, the call timeouts, the breaker values and the access token lifetime.

text: A policy has versions, a history and the default mark.
prefix: A policy has versions, a history and the default mark.

text: An installation setting is how one zone runs, and a change needs a new deployment.
prefix: An installation setting is how one zone runs, and a change needs a new deployment.

text: Later, the bank wants a shorter lifetime for one-time codes.
prefix: Later, the bank wants a shorter lifetime for one-time codes.

text: Nobody changes it in the administrator panel, because the panel changes no policy and no setting.
prefix: Nobody changes it in the administrator panel, because the panel changes no policy and no setting.

text: The platform team changes one line in the OpenTofu configuration, and applies it.
prefix: The platform team changes one line in the OpenTofu configuration, and applies it.

text: The platform checks the new value before it uses it.
prefix: The platform checks the new value before it uses it.

text: It refuses zero, a negative number, a wrong unit, or a value outside its allowed range.
prefix: It refuses zero, a negative number, a wrong unit, or a value outside its allowed range.

text: A typo cannot become a policy.

text: A valid value becomes a new version of the policy, and the earlier version stays in its history.
prefix: A valid value becomes a new version of the policy, and the earlier version stays in its history.

text: Texts follow the same path: a new consent text comes from the configuration, as a new version.
prefix: Texts follow the same path: a new consent text comes from the configuration, as a new version.

text: Back to the missing line.

text: The setup stopped, the team added the value, and version zero was complete.

text: The shorter code lifetime became version one, with its time and its source.
prefix: The shorter code lifetime became version one, with its time and its source.

text: Every value has a source, a version and an owner.

text: The defaults and the texts come from the OpenTofu configuration, as version zero.
